batches.title: GitHub certification official-source freshness scan
batches.selection_method: Every existing GitHub guide, plus a comparison against the live GitHub certification catalog and official September changelog.

official_blueprint_and_lifecycle.notes: The July 2026 objective and status snapshots still match the live study guide; no exam retirement or replacement was announced.

official_product_documentation.notes: Current registered enterprise-administration documentation remained reachable; canonical redirect debt is maintenance rather than missing evidence.

official_release_channels.notes: Six official runner, retention, migration, and GHES lifecycle sources were not registered and are queued for relevance review.

catalog_comparison.notes: Each discovered URL was compared with approved sources and the candidate inbox before queueing.

contradiction_and_gap_review.notes: No immediate contradictory GH-100 claim was verified; the queued sources may add bounded migration and lifecycle depth.

findings.title: GitHub Actions: Early September 2026 updates
findings.evidence: GitHub published a runner-version deprecation API and reusable-workflow identity fields on September 3, 2026.
findings.recommendation: Review for a concise runner lifecycle and GHES-availability boundary.

findings.title: Actions retention will cover checks, workflow runs, and statuses
findings.evidence: GitHub announced a broader retention-setting scope effective October 1, 2026.
findings.recommendation: Review administration and evidence-export guidance before the effective date.

findings.title: Deprecation of Node 20 on GitHub Actions runners
findings.evidence: The official timeline reaches Node 20 runner removal on September 23, 2026.
findings.recommendation: Review runner and action maintenance guidance for a dated warning.

findings.title: GitHub Actions minimum version enforcement timeline for self-hosted runners
findings.evidence: GitHub's published enforcement timeline includes a September 2026 GitHub Enterprise Cloud boundary.
findings.recommendation: Review for version-neutral runner lifecycle guidance plus the dated enforcement check.

findings.title: Enterprise Live Migrations from GHES to ghe.com generally available
findings.evidence: Enterprise Live Migrations became GA for a bounded GHES-to-GHEC Data Residency path on September 1, 2026.
findings.recommendation: Review whether a narrowly scoped GEI-versus-ELM decision note improves migration coverage.

findings.title: GitHub Enterprise Server releases
findings.evidence: The official ledger lists GHES version and support dates more precisely than moving @latest aliases.
findings.recommendation: Review as the canonical GHES lifecycle source while keeping guide prose version-neutral.

results.notes: No blueprint change was detected. Review work is limited to newly discovered official lifecycle sources.

findings.title: Deprecation of Node 20 on GitHub Actions runners

findings.title: Upcoming deprecation of GitHub Spark on github.com
findings.evidence: The github.com Spark workbench retired August 31, 2026, while the live blueprint still names Spark.
findings.recommendation: Retain conceptual blueprint coverage but remove implied hands-on availability.
findings.resolution: The guide now labels the github.com experience retired, preserves conceptual scope, and records the deployed-app and llm() boundaries.

findings.title: Content exclusions generally available in Copilot app and CLI
findings.evidence: Copilot CLI and the Copilot app now honor configured exclusions for Business and Enterprise customers.
findings.recommendation: Remove CLI from the unsupported list while retaining the IDE Agent-mode and secret-management limitations.
findings.resolution: The limitation, scenario answer, and readiness item now describe the current supported and unsupported surfaces.

findings.title: Copilot code review can now approve pull requests
findings.evidence: An assessment alone does not count, but an administrator-enabled preview approval can satisfy a required-approval rule.
findings.recommendation: Separate platform capability from accountable-human governance advice.
findings.resolution: The guide now explains the default-off preview, policy scopes, assessment distinction, and retained human accountability.

findings.title: Upcoming changes to GitHub Copilot policies and billing
findings.evidence: GitHub announced late-September policy, retention, billing, and code-review default changes.
findings.recommendation: Review for a dated upcoming-change note without replacing durable VERIFY CURRENT guidance.

findings.title: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models
findings.evidence: Four named models are scheduled to retire October 2, 2026.
findings.recommendation: Keep model names out of durable prose and use the current model list; consider this only as a lifecycle example.

results.notes: Three stale product statements were repaired immediately; two lower-durability release sources remain queued.
